The CMG persists tool observations as facts, binds attack hypotheses to falsifiable predicates, and propagates falsification deterministically along causal edges, severing every descendant of a dead end in one pass. Four complementary mechanisms close the four failure modes. A cascaded pruning engine falsifies hypotheses and blocks all their downstream paths, curbing rabbit holes. Goal verification, using exact flag matching and three anti-cheat anchors, eliminates flag hallucination. CMG-driven context compression keeps critical memory intact across long horizons at zero LLM cost, resisting state dissolution. Causal confidence flow and evidence starvation supply the explore–exploit switch, mitigating the imbalance. Evaluated on 32 real CVE tasks of PACEbench under four backbone LLMs across three scorable scenario types plus a defended scenario, CausalPT outperforms the strongest baseline by 20.0%–56.0% and 12.2%–50.2% in task level and fine grained composite scores, respectively.
